purpose: Manually construct and review a bounded domestic-action language tranche that integrates regional valency and person architecture with Hebrew-derived ordinary-life and communal material while preserving the future narrative system's boundaries.

manual_language_work.authoring_method: Direct Codex linguistic reasoning over individually reviewed Moraviantown Munsee and Biblical Hebrew evidence, the existing contact grammar, local exact and semantic retrieval, and the We Walk Well continuity ledger.
manual_language_work.automation_boundary: Code validates the manually declared source boundaries, contact forms, nine finite cells, host inventories, semantics, component roles, orthography, dependencies, firewalls, and continuity links. It did not choose or generate the language records.

source_boundary.honesty_boundary: Donor records preserve printed and analyzed source material exactly. Contact object inventories, a/o class bridges, miičii-o deletion, postclausal yaxad, phrase order, finite cells, and mixed syntax are explicit project design rather than claimed attested history.

domestic_absolute.morphophonemic_boundary: The full lexical stem remains miičii- in analysis; its final ii deletes only before contact TI bridge o in these three cells.
domestic_absolute.object_boundary: Every clause has one overt bare nondefinite class-compatible object. Count objects are singular and no object is plural-marked.

coactivity.boundary: Joint participation by the indexed first-plural group; not a comitative, reciprocal, ordinary coordinator, simultaneity-only marker, or narrative linker.

narrative_boundary.preserved_goal: The required narrative system still centers the specific interaction of Biblical Hebrew wayyiqtol and weqatal with Algonquian obviation and recoverable discourse tracking.

creative_anchor_gate.continuity_result: We Walk Well now links honest candidate substrates for inclusive eating in one house, a small child bringing bread, and eating together. Bring remains only a conflict probe for carry; plural possessed homes, definite small-child wording, route attachment to eating, clusivity choice, meter, owner review, and human acceptance remain open.
creative_anchor_gate.unchanged_anchor: When the Lights Learn Our Names received no false coverage: bringing a cup is not lifting it, sitting and eating is not setting a table, and ordinary clauses do not supply the narrative engine.
